changelog: v3: 'behind' → 'in front of' 수정 (선생님이 칠판 앞에 서도록)
v3: 오프닝/엔딩을 고정 클립으로 분리 (Grok 생성 아님)
v3: 나레이션 순차 재생 규칙 명시 (겹침 금지)
v3: 로마자는 화면 표시만, TTS 읽기 금지

_compositionGuide.layout: teacher RIGHT 30-35% IN FRONT OF chalkboard, chalkboard visible on LEFT 65-70%
_compositionGuide.textOverlayZone: chalkboard area — Grok 텍스트 금지, 후편집 합성
_compositionGuide.CRITICAL: 선생님은 칠판 앞(IN FRONT OF)에 서 있어야 함. behind 사용 금지.

_audioRule.CRITICAL: 한국어 나레이션과 영어 나레이션은 절대 동시 재생 금지. 반드시 순차 재생.
_audioRule.romanization: 화면에 텍스트로만 표시. TTS로 읽지 않음.

scenes.reusableNote: 모든 에피소드에서 동일하게 사용. 매번 새로 생성하지 않음.
scenes.subtitles: NONE — 자막/텍스트 오버레이 없음. 깨끗한 영상 그대로 사용.

narration.text: 안녕하세요. 여러분과 한글 공부를 같이 할 대한입니다.
narration.note: 이 나레이션은 오프닝 클립에 미리 내장. 에피소드 생성 시 별도 TTS 불필요.

scenes.prompt: Animate this 3D anime teacher character in a Korean classroom. COMPOSITION: The teacher stands IN FRONT OF a large green chalkboard, positioned on the RIGHT SIDE of the frame (30-35% width). The chalkboard is visible on the LEFT side (65-70% width) with a clean empty green surface — the teacher is clearly BETWEEN the camera and the chalkboard, not behind it. Medium shot showing the teacher from the waist up, camera at eye-level. MOTION: The teacher smiles warmly and points toward the chalkboard with her right hand in a gentle presenting gesture. She sways very slightly with natural breathing. LIGHTING: Warm overhead classroom lighting. FORMAT: Horizontal 16:9 widescreen. IMPORTANT: Do NOT generate any text, letters, numbers, Korean characters, subtitles, logos, or watermarks.

scenes.prompt: Animate this 3D anime teacher character leading a repeat-after-me drill in a Korean classroom. COMPOSITION: The teacher stands IN FRONT OF a large green chalkboard, positioned on the RIGHT SIDE of the frame (30-35% width). The clean chalkboard is visible on the LEFT (65-70%). The teacher is clearly BETWEEN the camera and the chalkboard. Medium shot, waist-up, eye-level. MOTION: The teacher faces the camera directly with a warm encouraging smile. She makes a slow rhythmic teaching gesture — gently moving her right hand in a follow-along beat pattern as if conducting a pronunciation drill. Her mouth opens and closes naturally as if speaking each word slowly. Between words she pauses and nods encouragingly. Patient supportive expression throughout, occasional gentle head tilts. LIGHTING: Calm soft classroom lighting. FORMAT: Horizontal 16:9. IMPORTANT: Do NOT generate any text, letters, word cards, subtitles, logos, or watermarks.
